items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1958-05-24
items.q: I was talking to Sheik about you.

ctx.x: I never met him. I heard Paul Balberin talk a lot about him. One of his favorites is not his favorite. Well, what did John McMurray play like? Isn't that his name? Mac Murray, they called it. I'm not sure of his first name. Did you know him? Mac Murray, the drummer. Did you ever know him? No. I never knew him.
I was talking to Sheik about you.
And he was telling me about it in Millenburg. And he said you would run everybody. He said you'd run Rene, Chris Kelly, and all of them.
